p.soil.title: Growing starts with the soil.
p.soil.lead: Living soil is a way of growing that values a living soil environment, where microbes and organic matter do their work. At GOKURAKU we look at the whole environment a plant grows in, and take care at every step from soil management to daily cultivation.
p.soil.dia: How soil, microbes and plants connect
p.soil.diaAlt: Soil cross-section: creatures in the soil break down organic matter on the surface, microbes and fungi turn it into a form plants can use, and the roots take it in.
p.soil.l1.d: Fallen leaves and other organic matter cover the surface.
p.soil.l2.d: Earthworms and other small creatures break it down.
p.soil.l3.d: They turn it into a form plants can use.
p.soil.l4.d: The plant takes up nutrients from the soil through its roots.
p.soil.f1.d: We prepare soil that microbes can live in.
p.soil.f2.d: We check every plant daily, watching water and conditions.
p.soil.f3.d: We decide when to harvest by the state of each plant.
p.soil.f4.d: Each flower is trimmed by hand, one at a time.
p.soil.note: This describes how we grow. It is not a claim about effects.
p.craft.title: Japanese craft, in every detail.
p.craft.lead: Every step matters, from growing to the final finish. At GOKURAKU we value the attention to detail that Japanese craftspeople have built up over generations, and we manage quality carefully by reading the condition of each plant.
c.env.d: We check every plant daily, watching water and the grow environment.
c.harvest.d: We read the condition of each plant to decide when to harvest.
c.trim.d: Harvested flowers are trimmed by hand, one at a time.
